These JPEG files were produced by tests/oracle/gen_jpeg.py (function round3) by running the ISO/IEC 10918
reference software ("libjpeg" by Thomas Richter, v1.70, https://github.com/thorfdbg/libjpeg) on synthetic
images generated by that script. No third party image content and no third party code is contained here;
the .ref files hold the decodes of libjpeg-turbo 3 (via imagecodecs) or of the reference software itself.
